content.short: ValueRouter is a token routing protocol for Web3.
content.description: ValueRouter enables users to route or swap any token on any chain to any token on any other chain in a single transaction. The platform simplifies cross‑chain trading by integrating Circle CCTP for cross‑chain transfers and by aggregating DEXs on both the source and destination chains. In the long term, ValueRouter aims to become a comprehensive dApp aggregator, allowing users to access and use any dApp on any chain from any other chain through a unified experience.
